meta.name: Tutorial 02: Energy Budget
meta.description: A compact level where the direct route fights current and the longer route can save energy.

campaign.concept: Shorter paths are not always better if currents fight the glider
learningObjectives: Compare a direct route against a current-assisted route.
Conserve energy while still sampling a valuable ROI hotspot.

planningPrompts.title: Watch the energy budget
planningPrompts.body: Every commanded move costs energy. A short path through opposing current can still be expensive.

planningPrompts.title: Find the assisted lane
planningPrompts.body: Try dropping into the lower current lane, riding east, then turning back toward the ROI hotspot.
